blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) is intensifying efforts to locate three suspected “micro-scam hubs,” as criminal groups allegedly shift to smaller, concealed facilities to evade authorities. “We will tighten the net, pursue every credible lead, and work relentlessly to identify those behind these schemes,” said NCRPO Officer-in-Charge Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano in a statement on Thursday. The move follows Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla’s disclosure that three operations remain active, although their locations have yet to be determined.
